title: Carrot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Carrot body -->
  <polygon points='50,95 30,20 70,20' fill='#FF8C00' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Carrot body lighter side -->
  <polygon points='50,95 50,20 70,20' fill='#FFA040'/>
  <!-- Carrot stripes -->
  <line x1='38' y1='35' x2='58' y2='35' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='48' x2='61' y2='48' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='61' x2='58' y2='61' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='74' x2='55' y2='74' stroke='#CC6600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Green leaves -->
  <path d='M50,20 C48,10 38,2 32,6 C36,14 42,18 50,20' fill='#33CC33' stroke='#66FF66' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50,20 C52,8 62,0 68,4 C64,13 58,18 50,20' fill='#2AB82A' stroke='#66FF66' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50,20 C50,6 56,-2 60,2 C58,10 54,16 50,20' fill='#44DD44' stroke='#66FF66' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3A1F00'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='38' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3A1F00'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#FFE8CC'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#FFE8CC'/>
  <!-- Eyebrows -->
  <path d='M37,30 Q42,27 47,30' stroke='#3A1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53,30 Q58,27 63,30' stroke='#3A1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40,46 Q50,58 60,46' stroke='#3A1F00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FF6666' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FF6666' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
